choice.description: Does the response fully and correctly satisfy the request? Rubric — false: The response has any substantive error or misses any explicit requirement.; true: The response fully and correctly satisfies every explicit request, including method, edge cases, units, formatting, and retained facts..

contexts: {"request": "A bakery makes 3 batches of 24 rolls. Twelve rolls are reserved for an order. The rest are packed equally into 5 display baskets, with any leftovers kept in the kitchen. State rolls per basket and leftovers, showing integer division.", "response": "There are 3 \u00d7 24 = 72 rolls total. After reserving 12, 60 remain. Integer division gives 60 \u00f7 5 = 12 remainder 0, so each basket receives 12 rolls and none are left in the kitchen."}
